summary: SIMPPLE LTD., a Cayman Islands company listed in the U.S., filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, disclosing amendments to its insider trading policy. The policy, adopted June 12, 2026, defines trading windows for directors, officers, and certain employees, permitting trades from the third business day after earnings release until the fifteenth calendar day before period end. A routine governance disclosure with no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or capital actions. No deal terms or strategic events involved; purely administrative compliance filing.
